text: ここから　そとに　でられるぞ！

structure.jp: そとに　でられるぞ！

patterns.name: 〜られる (potential)
patterns.explanation: でる 'go out' changed to でられる means 'can go out'. でられる = 'can get out'.

patterns.name: 〜ぞ
patterns.explanation: ぞ at the end is a rough, mostly male way to stress what you are telling someone. でられるぞ = 'you can get out, hey!'
